hints.text: The sum of set bits in (a or b) plus (a and b) equals the sum of set bits in a plus set bits in b.

hints.title: Deduplication
hints.text: Pairs must be formed from distinct values, so remove duplicates from the input list first.

hints.title: Two Pointer Bit Count Sum
hints.text: Sort the bit counts of unique numbers, then use two pointers to count pairs summing to at least k.

hints.title: Sorted Bit Counts Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def countExcellentPairs(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
        unique_nums = list(set(nums))
        bit_counts = [bin(x).count('1') for x in unique_nums]
        bit_counts.sort()
        ans = 0
        n = len(bit_counts)
        j = n - 1
        for i in range(n):
            while j >= 0 and bit_counts[i] + bit_counts[j] >= k:
                j -= 1
            ans += (n - 1 - j)
        return ans
```

variables: n: number of elements in nums
complexity.notes: Bit counts calculation and sorting of unique values.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all pairs with bitwise operators takes O(n^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Unique set and bit counts array require linear space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Discovers the bit count equivalence: popcount(a | b) + popcount(a & b) = popcount(a) + popcount(b).
